Recipe:
Crispy Peanut Butter Cookies about 36 Adapted from the Cooking Channel web site
§ion;
We have tried many different recipes for Peanut Butter Cookies. Josh found this recipe and although he used the correct ingredients, he totally ignored the directions and did things his own way. The results were quite different from anything else we have tried. The cookies are a lot thinner than others, and they are a bit crispy on the bottom and edges. They are now Di's all-time favorite.
Flour2 Cups Baking Soda½ teaspoon Salt¼ teaspoon Browns Sugar1¼ Cups Sugar1¼ Cups
ButterSoftened 1 Cup2 Sticks
Eggs3
Peanut ButterChunky or Creamy 1 Cup2 Sticks
Vanilla2 teaspoons
In a large bowl, mix Flour, Baking Soda, Salt, Brown Sugar and Sugar.
Add Butter and mix with a rubber spatula until it is blended in.
Add Eggs, Peanut Butter and Vanilla, and mix well.
Place 1-inch balls of dough ≈2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for 18-20 minutes.
The dough is really sticky, so making the balls can end up being a bit of a chore.
